title: 'Range-Limited Pursuit-Evasion'
authors:

year: '2023'
doi: '10.1109/NAECON58068.2023.10365808'

image: 'featured.jpg'
abstract: |
  In pursuit-evasion the objective of the pursuer is to capture the evader. In
  this work, the faster pursuer is modeled to have limited range and therefore
  optimal strategies for the pursuer and evader change. Depending upon the range
  limits of the pursuer the evader may evade capture by the pursuer. This paper
  describes the optimal strategies and nuances that appear for point-capture or
  when the pursuer is endowed with a non-zero capture radius.
